notes.text: I packed two green boots for the river walk and one grey satchel for school. Both kinds of packed items are waterproof.

origin.variation: Later stable property applies to both complete participants/actions

notes.text: I packed two dry towels for the sauna. Only after I unpacked them, those towels became wet in the rain.

origin.variation: Later change must not replace dry state at packing; accept explicit chronology in full wording

notes.text: I packed two orange jackets for camping and one blue helmet for a cycling lesson. The helmet is not waterproof; the jackets are waterproof.

origin.variation: Later different stable properties attach separately to their complete action participants
